sam: Heads-up — nightly perf job for small-batch inference regressed after the runtime merge that pulled in the Triton autotune change. p50 for seq=16, batch=1 went from ~14ms -> ~19ms on A100 in CI. Noticed around 03:20 UTC.

nina: saw that too in the canary pool. NVProf/NSYS shows the attention call choosing a GEMM-centric kernel instead of the small-seq attention path; obvious extra memcpy and kernel launch overhead. attaching short nsys snippet.

nina: ```
# nsys summary (trimmed)
kernel: attention_gemm_fallback  time(ms): 9.2  calls: 128
kernel: attention_small_seq_opt  time(ms): 2.6  calls: 128
Memcpy H2D extra: 0.8ms
KV cache memcpy stalls: +1.1ms
```

yuji: bisect points to commit abcdef1c (triton: autotune selector heuristic). The selector now scores based on a `tensor_ops` estimate that accidentally multiplies by sequence_length twice for the small-seq path, biasing toward the GEMM kernel. Definitely a cost-model bug.

dev-ci: CI job https://ci.internal/reports/eng-runtime/perf-smallbatch/342 failed: p50=19.4ms, p95=34ms, regression delta p50 +39%. Smoke tests flagged it as rollout-blocker.

carmen: This landed on main and is blocking the Dedicated canary rollout tonight. Can we revert the autotune toggle until fix is in?

sam: opened revert PR https://git.internal/repo/PR/789 and started a rollback on the triton-autotune deployment in canary. Command used: `kubectl -n runtime rollout undo deploy/triton-autotune --to-revision=3` — monitoring.

nina: after rolling back selector on canary the small-batch p50 dropped back to ~14.6ms. Also observed KV cache miss rate go from ~2% -> ~11% while the bad selector was active. That explains the extra memcpy stalls.

yuji: repro steps I used locally: 1) checkout abcdef1c; 2) build runtime image; 3) run perf harness: `./perf/run --model llama-7b --seq 16 --batch 1 --iters 200` 4) profile with nsys. Confirmed kernel choice flip.

mlops: sorry about the break — that change was meant to improve large-sequence throughput. I'll revert in-tree and push a corrected cost-estimator with a unit test covering small-seq scoring. ETA a PR in ~2 hours.

sam: thanks. Leaving canary rolled back and pausing the Dedicated rollout until fix merges + CI confirms. Created tracking issue #456 and assigned to @mlops. Please post CI perf numbers after your patch so we can unpause. :thumbsup:
